limitations: Not a claim of byte-identical s01..s17 standalone files: s15 itself integrates s01..s14, with s09 imported; host wrappers add transport, traces, knowledge, goal, workflow and one worktree transaction fix.
Native SimpleJsonSchema implements a small subset; integer accepts floats.
Native TodoWrite accepts empty lists and multiple in_progress items.
Native durable-cron loader swallows malformed-state errors; do not promise corruption recovery.
Native released task resets plan gate; require_plan is not a permanent policy for future assignments.
Goal restore is a native controller operation, not a cross-process CLI session-resume feature.
Real provider truncation is not enforced by local transport; protocol branches use explicit fixtures.
MCP discovery uses the upstream in-process stand-in; deploy is simulated, mounted docs are actual filesystem content.
POSIX process groups and worktrees do not contain hostile processes that create a new session.
scope_note: All 17 declared mechanism contracts plus the composed normal/error/boundary exercise verified; not exhaustive equivalence across upstream releases/platforms.
